evidence: Three chapter-0 rides replay the original's recorded inputs step for step (worst delta 0); unit tests cover touch hold objectives, start=1 player mode, the chapter 1-6 floor and colliders and journey totals; remote software-GL captures in evidence/audit-fix/g24.
limits: Seven chapters. Chapter 0 uses the original's measured floor and 1400 colliders; chapters 1-6 use this game's own terrain as the floor and colliders built from their scattered props, not the original's (never captured).
No voiced scenes, creatures, exploration or field notes; herd objectives are plain ring routes.
Procedural and CC0/Meshy art; independent reconstruction of the mechanics, not a pixel-parity or 1:1 port.
Verified in remote software WebGL2 (SwiftShader) only, not on a hardware GPU or a real phone.

checks.name: mounts examples port without code duplication
